files.title: AMB Rain Loop 1
files.author: Kresiek The Furry
files.processing: 40 s selection from 22 s, 44.1 kHz stereo, highpass 120 Hz, lowpass 4300 Hz, gain +1 dB, 0.8 s equal-power wrap crossfade, Vorbis q4; mixed in gently only as rain strengthens

runtime: One application player, 1.4 s fade in, 1.05 s fade out. Separate intensity mix, no pitch manipulation or synthetic droplet oscillator. The decoded codec edge is smoothly connected over the final 12 ms without a silence gap. Controls and page changes keep the same sources. Snow keeps the existing quiet original air layer.
